managers.message_to_team: The memo says to write a note whenever you can, and any mark counts, so please add one to every cup today. I know we're down a partner, but keep the drive-through timer in mind and use a quick smiley or heart if that's what fits.
managers.private_thought: I don't want handwritten notes slowing the window or creating a gray area, but the memo is clear and I expect us to follow it.

managers.message_to_team: If you’ve got a spare moment, add a quick smiley or ‘enjoy’ to a cup. Don’t slow the line or leave your extra position to do it—skip it when we’re busy.
managers.private_thought: A note is fine if it doesn’t cost us cups per labor hour, and today we’re already covering a callout.

managers.message_to_team: Corporate’s encouraging cup notes, so if you’ve got a second, add a smiley or a quick ‘enjoy’—make it yours. We’re one partner down, so don’t let it slow you or make the shift harder; take care of each other and the customers first.
